messages:
sam: Hi folks — need to add my 30yo brother as a dependent (he's permanently disabled). He moved in with me on 2026-09-10 but his SSN is delayed because he applied from abroad. Can we get coverage retro to 2026-09-10?

maria (People Ops): Hi Sam — thanks for flagging. For adult disabled dependents we usually need: SSA award letter or treating physician note, proof you provide financial support (bank transfers, lease, affidavit), and an ID (passport). SSN is required eventually but we can provisionally enroll while SSN is pending. Did he move in as a Qualifying Life Event or was this a late notice?

sam: It was a QLE (change in household) but I didn't submit within 30 days due to mailing delays overseas. I filed the SSN request on 2026-09-12 — embassy processing delay.

lina (Benefits): Ok. If it's outside the 30-day window we need a "Late Dependent Add Exception" request. Submit the exception form plus supporting docs and a short explanation of the mailing/processing delays. We consider international processing as a legitimate reason frequently.

sam: What exactly should I upload? My brother has an SSA letter, passport, copies of bank transfers showing I pay his rent, and a Spanish physician note. Does the physician note need an apostille?

lina (Benefits): Please upload: 1) SSA/SSDI award letter (pdf), 2) passport scan, 3) proof of financial support (bank statements or a signed affidavit), 4) physician statement. For foreign clinician notes a certified English translation is acceptable; apostille not required unless the document's authenticity is in question. Include translator contact info on the translated doc.

hr-bot: Form: /hr/forms/late-dependent-exception_v2.pdf (fillable). Upload to Workday under Benefits > Attachments or use this link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/forms/late-dependent-exception

dan (Payroll): If approved retro, we will backdate premium deductions and apply any payroll adjustments. Important: we need the SSN within 60 days of approval or we may reverse retro deductions per payroll policy. Also note HSA eligibility: adding a dependent may change your HSA/family plan implications; please confirm plan type before electing contributions.

sam: Got it. Any naming convention for files? I have a bunch to upload.

maria (People Ops): Simple names are best, e.g., `sam_brother_ssdi_2026-09.pdf`, `sam_late-exception_2026-10.pdf`. Bundle into one Workday upload if possible.

sam: Uploaded: sam_late-exception_2026-10.pdf, sam_ssdi_2026-09.pdf, sam_passport_2026-09.pdf, sam_bank-transfer_2026-09.pdf, phys_translated_2026-09.pdf

lina (Benefits): Received. We'll triage today and aim to reply within 4 business days. If we approve the exception we'll notify Payroll and update enrollment effective 2026-09-10.

sam: Thanks all — appreciate quick turnaround.

maria (People Ops): Note for the record: if SSN doesn't arrive within the timeframe, Benefits will coordinate with Payroll to reconcile premiums. Sam — please follow up in this thread when the SSN posts so we can close the case. :white_check_mark:
